title: objectql: a lookup with `deleteBehavior: "restrict"` is overridden when the same parent is also the child's master_detail target — deleting the parent cascade-deletes the child instead of refusing 409
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named. Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch. ## Symptom A restrict lookup is supposed to block deleting a referenced parent. When the child also holds a master_detail to the very same parent row, the cascade runs first and the child is deleted; the restrict never fires. ## Reproduction 1. Object `widget_part` (parent). Child object with `f_master_detail → widget_part` (required) and `f_lookup → widget_part` with `deleteBehavior: "restrict"`. 2. Create parent P; create a child with both fields = P. 3. `DELETE /api/v1/data/widget_part/

` → 200 and the child is gone. 4. Control: the child points its two fields at different parents → deleting the lookup parent → 409 DELETE_RESTRICTED. ## Expected Restrict wins (409 DELETE_RESTRICTED naming the restricting field), or the spec refuses this combination at save time; never a silent cascade past a declared restrict. ## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies) Suspected `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` referential walk: master_detail cascade evaluated before lookup restrict. ## Filing facts - reach: `DELETE /api/v1/data/…`, measured by the Data QA card twice with a control. - Business reason: Restrict is how authors protect referenced records; here data the author declared undeletable is destroyed. - Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:server`, `area:data`, p2. - Dedupe: semantic search `lookup deleteBehavior restrict overridden by master_detail cascade delete same parent` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 21 hits, none on restrict-vs-cascade ordering (nearest closed #22957 tree deleteBehavior, #24964). - QA id: S4
